why: reads a field of the `.nros_boot_config` blob — RFC-0045's baked rung. ROS 2 has no counterpart because a desktop node gets its identity from argv and the environment, neither of which a device has. issue 0794: the blob has always defined four fields and C exposed ONE accessor, so even a correctly-baked value could not be read from C. An out-parameter with a `bool` return rather than a sentinel, because 0 is a VALID domain — the same reason `NROS_DOMAIN_ID_EXPLICIT_ZERO` exists on the init path (issues 0206/0227). As with the locator, no producer sets it yet.
